newsitem.title: INDIA: Air India expects 97/98 net at $25.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Air India expects 97/98 net at $25.5 mln.

text.p: State-owned foreign carrier Air India said on Thursday that it expected to earn a net profit of 912.6 million rupees ($25.49 million) in fiscal 1997/98 (April-March).

"We are basing our profit numbers on our achievements in the first quarter of calendar 1997," Brajesh Kumar, Managing Director of Air India told reporters. "We expect to have a similar performance for the rest of the year."

Air India's profit, as projected in its budget estimates for the current financial year is based on revenues of 41.89 billion rupees. The company had suffered losses of 2.8 billion rupees on revenues of 34.77 billion last year, a company statement said.

The budget estimates are based on an increase in Air India's passengers to 3.05 million from 2.91 million a year and an increase in the overall load factor to 65.7 percent from 60.3 percent, the statement said.
Air India recorded a profit in January 1997 for the first time in over 16 months.
